decisions.statement: A command has as many aliases as a caller adds.
A subcommand has subcommands of its own.
A command may not become an ancestor of itself.
The game's own slash commands are offered for completion beside the added ones.
A completion is colored by which of the four kinds the command is.
A description is a string or a call answering a string.
The game's chat entry is hooked rather than replaced.
The game reaches the library through one global name.

definition: a slash command another addon registers, and the chat completion offering it
